imageIntro: Compress photos and animations in batches. Keep their format, transparency and motion.
pdfIntro: Smaller documents with readable text and the original page layout.
audioIntro: Compress audio in batches with control over quality, bitrate and format.
limits: Up to 20 files per batch · {size} per file
sizeLimit: Choose a non-empty file up to {size}.
batchLimit: Choose up to 20 files per batch.
sameType: Upload images, PDFs, audio or videos separately. Do not mix file types.
uploadRetry: Some uploads did not finish. Retry or remove the failed files to continue.
imagelight: Keep more detail with gentle optimization
imagebalanced: A balance of quality and file size
imagestrong: Smaller files with some loss of detail
pdfbalanced: Optimize images while keeping them clear
pdfstrong: Smaller embedded images, intact text layer
imageNote: Keep the original format and dimensions. HEIC uses JPG previews; downloads remain HEIC. Files with unsupported auxiliary layers are preserved unchanged.
pdfNote: Keep text and page structure. No OCR is added. Encrypted and digitally signed PDFs are not supported yet.
audioNote: Automatic settings do not raise the sample rate. Mono and stereo are retained; surround audio is mixed to stereo. A listening copy is provided for incompatible inputs.
quota: Up to 20 uploads per 24 hours and 20 unfinished tasks at a time. Credit usage is confirmed before processing.
privacy: Private files. Automatically deleted after 24 hours, or delete them whenever you like.
zipSuccessOnly: The ZIP includes successful files only. Failed, cancelled and expired files are excluded.
emptyResults: The files in this batch have been deleted.
previewFailed: Preview is unavailable. Download the file to view it.
UNCHANGED: Already optimized. The original file has been kept because it is no larger.
LARGER: The result is larger than the original. Your chosen format and settings were kept; try a lower bitrate.
PARTIAL_OPTIMIZATION: Some complex images were kept unchanged; other supported content was optimized.
